Subject: Private VPC architecture review - post-call recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today, Samantha - really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Goals you called out: run sensitive customer workloads on a private Redwood deployment (VPC) with strict network egress controls, KMS integration, and predictable latency SLAs.
- Current constraints: on-premise NATs and legacy IP ranges, separate SSO tenant, and a procurement timeline that targets proof-of-concept in Q3.
- Success criteria: private control plane, data residency in us-east, audit logs to satisfy SOC2 scope, and <50ms p95 token latency for typical inference paths.

Next step: technical architecture review (30-45m) where our Solutions Engineer will walk through the VPC topology options, KMS/HSM integration, and required network/port-level changes for a Private deployment. Suggested slots next week (PT):

1) Tue 2028-05-29 10:00-10:45 PT
2) Wed 2028-05-30 14:00-14:45 PT

If those don't work, please share your preferred windows and I can align. Please confirm who from your infra/security team should join - I recommend including your cloud architect for routing/NAT discussion.

I'll circulate an agenda and attach a short template agenda for the review once we lock a time.

Thanks,
